title.description: Short project title, same language as the user request.

imagePrompt.description: Art-direction prompt for the image model (English art direction is fine); do not include copy that exists as blocks.

imagePrompts.description: Only for multi-page series: one prompt per page. Null otherwise.

outline.description: Only in outline mode: 3-6 short planning bullets. Null otherwise.

copy.description: Legacy single-copy field. Prefer blocks[]; null when blocks are used.

blocks.description: Free-form text blocks that become editable native text layers. Zero/one/many — decide from the request. Null only when the plan format predates blocks.

role.description: Free-form: headline, price, discount, date, name, slogan, subtitle…

text.description: The exact copy, in the user's language.

styleHint.description: Optional styling/placement hint (e.g. 'large bold, top'). Null when none.
